question: Should restrictive sessions_spawn inheritance include concrete MCP/LSP tools that are present in the parent’s final policy-filtered, schema-compatible tool surface?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent and preserves final filtering, but it deliberately restores access to tools that previous child sessions silently omitted; that security/compatibility contract needs an owner’s explicit confirmation.

options.title: Accept final-surface inheritance
options.body: Confirm that children may inherit every concrete tool on the parent’s final permitted surface, then merge after normal exact-head checks.

options.title: Keep the earlier core-only cap
options.body: Reject runtime-tool inheritance for restricted child sessions and close this fix in favor of documenting or redesigning the policy boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept final-surface inheritance
recommendation.body: Confirm that children may inherit every concrete tool on the parent’s final permitted surface, then merge after normal exact-head checks.
